review.imagery: Forty-one gallery entries comprise thirty-one own-project renders and ten historical site photographs. All twenty-four current primary files, the complete forty-five-page brochure index, nineteen extracted native resources and all ten September 2026 site photographs were visually reviewed. The exact duplicate primary banner is excluded. Eight additional native scenes supply lobby details, gym corridor, bedrooms, duplex and bathroom. Paper, marble, water and fabric textures and generic lifestyle people photographs are excluded. The complete street building supplies the card and hero. Developer-published historical site images retain their September 2026 date and photograph flag.
review.floorPlans: Fifteen complete original building sheets show the ground, podium 2, residential levels 1–14 and roof, including the printed paired-level sheets and duplex upper levels. Podium 1 is absent from this packet. Three separate freely displayed broker images add 1 BR typical, Type 04 and Type 07 previews. Those standalone images show no printed saleable areas or numbered-unit references. The broker’s remaining drawings require a form and were not retrieved. Confirm contractual unit matching, duplex levels and final areas with Imtiaz. Every one of the fifteen complete drawing sheets was visually reviewed on four whole-sheet contacts. All three public standalone home images were separately viewed at their native size. Their file labels are preserved as broker labels and do not establish numbered-unit contracts or numerical areas. Full sheets retain their view directions, orientation, level keys, color legends, unit arrangements, source branding and notices. Published category minimums and broker inventory ranges are not assigned to drawings.
review.location: Complete brochure pages 7 and 8 and the complete original one-page fact sheet were visually reviewed. The primary’s named-place embed has no explicit target coordinates, so its camera centre is excluded. Dubai Islands map scope, proposed district context and project-name directions are preserved. The source map supplies no numerical travel estimates. Broker pages publish inconsistent times and prices, which are not imported into this media update.
review.provenance: Current official HTML/gallery media and the September construction-history page have dated URL and byte/hash receipts. Tanami hosts the branded brochure and Mitchell’s hosts the sixteen-page floorplate packet. Three freely displayed full home-preview image URLs were observed in Silver Oak’s public project section. The other form-gated plans were left unretrieved. All broker resources retain honest attribution, native images and source links. Protected text research and identities remain intact.

unavailable: Verified individual home saleable areas and numbered-unit contracts, podium 1, the broker’s form-gated remaining home drawings, exact visitor entrance, numerical original-source travel estimates, final views/furniture and certified current construction progress remain unavailable or unverified.
